BOUNDARY: Paramecium NEVER multiplies by conjugation (conjugation makes 2 NEW VARIETIES, not 4 daughters). Micro nucleus divides by MEIOSIS; macro does not. The MICRONUCLEUS = "the germline"; the MACRONUCLEUS = "the body line". Encystation â‰ reproduction â€” it is a RESTING stage that lets the cell survive drought; it is the reason Paramecium persists in dried pond scrapes.
